about.title: About Me
description: My path into software started with an infrastructure internship at Collective[i], an AI startup. Working close to cloud systems taught me that software doesn't end when the code ships — it still has to be secure, observable, affordable, and understandable when something breaks.

Now I'm a software engineer at Packsize, working mainly in C# and React. I like untangling hard problems, understanding how the pieces actually fit together, and leaving code easier to reason about than I found it. My infrastructure background still shapes how I build: I think about how something will run and fail — not just for my team, but across the product.
Outside work, I rebuild cars, snowboard in the winter, and ride motorcycles in the summer. I've always liked working with my hands as much as my head.
